lastCompletedStory.title: CRITICAL: `gship claude --help` still prints the retired command 7 times

openQuestions: US-R2-002 (already staged, priority 2) is the correct home for the 15 user-facing RUNTIME remediation strings across plan.ts/ship.ts/next.ts/review.ts/issue.ts/spec.ts/run.ts/setup.ts/pause.ts/src/logging/screen.ts -- deliberately not touched by this story per its own scope (title/usage/Examples/Config in claude.ts) plus the one same-class fix in retry-monitor.ts's HELP_REGISTRY entry that the widened test itself required to stay green.

src/commands/retry-monitor.ts still has two stderr 'Usage: cam retry-monitor <pane> <pid>' remediation strings and a '[cam retry-monitor]' log-tag prefix that were NOT renamed: the log-tag form matches the widespread, still-unrenamed `[cam]`/`[cam <subcommand>]` internal log-identity convention used across dozens of call sites in src/ (verified via grep, none renamed by any prior US-002/003/004/005 story), and the 'Usage: ...' remediation strings are the exact class US-R2-002 is staged to sweep -- flagging both so US-R2-002's own coverage-derivation catches retry-monitor.ts's two Usage strings too, not just the 15 already enumerated in its description.

The AC1 oracle text embedded in US-002's (already passes:true) prd.json entry still hand-types its 12-command list; prd.json is not writable by the implementer, so the durable fix lives only in test/help-registry.test.ts's new derived-from-HELP_REGISTRY sweep, not in the historical oracle string itself.
nextStoryContext: src/commands/claude.ts's CLAUDE_HELP block (title/usage/Examples/Routing/Config) now renders `gship claude` throughout; internal-contract paths (~/.config/cam/retry.toml, ~/.cam/retry-logs/, /cam-next, /cam-plan) are unchanged by design (pinned internal-contract layers per ADR-0054, not typed-command invocations). test/help-registry.test.ts gained a new describe block, 'no retired `cam <word>` command survives in any help text (US-R2-001, CAM-460)', that loops Object.keys(HELP_REGISTRY) -- the single source of truth COMMANDS/HELP_REGISTRY already enforce at typecheck time (US-001, CAM-278) -- against the exact boundary regex from US-002's own oracle (/(^|[^a-zA-Z_/-])cam /), plus a top-level `gship --help` check. This sweep is now the durable, non-tautological replacement for US-002's hand-typed 12-command oracle list. Running it against the current tree (not just against main) found a second live instance of the same defect outside this story's originally-cited file -- src/commands/retry-monitor.ts's RETRY_MONITOR_HELP (title/usage/Behaviour/footer) -- fixed in the same commit so the widened test is genuinely green rather than narrowed back to a known-good subset. Full `bun run check:all` is green: 5992 pass / 0 fail, typecheck clean, embed-vendor up to date (this story touched no vendor/templates files), coverage/dead-code/dup/ci-parity/agents-md/test-sleeps/skip-ratchet all ok. Next non-operator, passes:false story by priority is US-R2-002 (priority 2, already staged in prd.json): the 15 user-facing RUNTIME remediation strings across plan.ts/ship.ts/next.ts/review.ts/issue.ts/spec.ts/run.ts/setup.ts/pause.ts/src/logging/screen.ts that still instruct the retired `cam` command at the moment of failure -- see openQuestions for the two retry-monitor.ts Usage strings that class of sweep should also catch.
